features: 550 TVL horizontal resolution, analog CVBS output (1.0 Vp-p, 75 Ohm)
Day/night with removable IR-cut filter; SensUp slow shutter up to 1 s
Wide Dynamic Range 92 dB (50 dB with WDR off)
Image stabilization; Sodium Vapor White Balance mode
Pan 360 deg continuous; preset speed pan 360 deg/s, tilt 100 deg/s; variable 0.1-120 deg/s
99 pre-positions, preset tour and two recorded tours
Bilinx over coax/UTP, Biphase, Pelco P/D, RS-232/RS-485 control
7 alarm inputs (2 EOLR supervised), 1 relay + 3 open-collector outputs
Indoor pendant housing, clear acrylic bubble (housing design rating IP66 per datasheet)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AutoDome_600_Data_sheet_enUS_18014400986189579.pdf, V18 2018), 36x Day/Night column and Indoor Pendant column. VG5-614-PCS = PAL, VG5-624-PCS = NTSC (same 36x indoor pendant camera, clear acrylic bubble). Sensitivity: min_lux_color = day mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.66 lux), min_lux = night mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.104 lux). The datasheet rates the indoor pendant housing IP66, but it is an indoor-only model (-10 to 40 C), so ip_rating is left out and noted in features. Power 15 W / 27 VA typical. Analog camera: no IP streaming.
